title: Trinity S³AI Framework: Complete Research Collection v6.0 with Figures and Data
description:
Trinity S³AI (Sacred Symbolic AI) Framework v6.0 presents a comprehensive approach to ternary computing with 40+ documented innovations across 7 research domains, now enhanced with publication-ready figures, supplementary data, and Docker reproducibility containers. (1) Ternary Neural Networks — HSLM-1.95M achieves PPL 125.3 on TinyStories with 20× memory compression; (2) Zero-DSP FPGA — Pure LUT-based inference requiring 0 DSP blocks with 37.8% LUT reduction; (3) TRI-27 ISA — 27-register balanced ternary instruction set with Coptic 3-bank encoding; (4) Queen Lotus Cycle — 6-phase autonomous orchestration with Jaccard similarity retrieval; (5) Tri Language — Linear types, algebraic effects, dual-target codegen to Zig/Verilog; (6) Sacred GF16/TF3 — φ-optimal number formats with 98.4% information retention; (7) VSA Operations — HybridBigInt SIMD achieving 17.2× speedup.

**v6.0 Enhancements:**
- **Publication-ready figures**: 14 PNG/SVG diagrams for all bundles
- **Supplementary data**: 9 CSV files with experimental results
- **Docker reproducibility**: 7 containerized environments
- **Standardized keywords**: MeSH + ACM CCS taxonomy
- **Cross-bundle references**: Full DOI network

**Bundle DOIs:**
- B001: 10.5281/zenodo.19227733 (Ternary Neural Networks)
- B002: 10.5281/zenodo.19227735 (Zero-DSP FPGA)
- B003: 10.5281/zenodo.19227737 (TRI-27 ISA)
- B004: 10.5281/zenodo.19227739 (Queen Lotus Cycle)
- B005: 10.5281/zenodo.19227741 (Tri Language)
- B006: 10.5281/zenodo.19227743 (Sacred GF16/TF3)
- B007: 10.5281/zenodo.19227745 (VSA Operations)

All implementations are pure Zig 0.15.x with zero external dependencies, complete reproducibility artifacts, and MLSys reproducibility cards.
